lines.en: label shrine25:
scene shrine_noon
It’s another hot day here at the end of Summer.
lines.zh: 又是夏末一个炎热的日子。

lines.en: The shrine is uncrowded, as per usual on days like this.
lines.zh: 神社里没什么人，这种日子向来如此。

lines.en: A cool breeze sweeps through the grounds and provides temporary respite from the harsh rays of the sun.
lines.zh: 一阵凉风扫过境内，让人暂时躲开毒辣的阳光。

lines.en: Maya is nowhere to be found.
lines.zh: Maya 不见踪影。

lines.en: She’s probably hiding from me.
lines.zh: 她大概在躲我。

lines.en: She seems to do that rather frequently, I’m finding.
lines.zh: 我发现她似乎经常这么做。

lines.en: It’s a little confusing given that I’ve never really gotten anything out of it other than seeing her in a cute outfit, but...
lines.zh: 这有点让人纳闷，因为除了看她穿一身可爱的衣服之外，我从这事儿里其实什么都没得到，不过……

lines.en: There are plenty of girls in plenty of places- each with their own cute outfits.
lines.zh: 有那么多女孩待在那么多地方——每个都有自己的一身可爱衣服。

lines.en: Why am I gravitating to the one who’d sooner save a watermelon from falling off of a cliff than me?
lines.zh: 我为什么偏偏被那个宁愿去救一颗从悬崖上掉下去的西瓜、也不会救我的人吸引？

lines.en: Sure, there aren’t many scenarios I can imagine where she’d be forced to choose between those two things-
lines.zh: 当然，我想象不出有多少场景会逼她在两者之间做出选择——

lines.en: But we all know which one she’d pick if she was forced to.
lines.zh: 可如果被逼着选，我们都知道她会选哪个。

lines.en: scene black
I take a look around the shrine, checking all of her usual spots.
lines.zh: 我环顾神社，把她平时待的地方都检查了一遍。

lines.en: She’s not in any of them.
lines.zh: 她一个都不在。

lines.en: Wait. No.
lines.zh: 等等。不对。

lines.en: She has to be somewhere.
lines.zh: 她总得在某个地方。

lines.en: Every time I think to myself, “Maybe she has the day off,” I wind up finding her in another peculiar place.
lines.zh: 每次我心里刚想「也许她今天休息」，结果就会在另一个古怪的地方找到她。

lines.en: I just need to completely scan the area...
lines.zh: 我只需要把这片区域彻底扫一遍……

lines.en: scene mayaglow1
After another five minutes or so, I spot her finding refuge in an old, otherwise unused booth of the shrine.
lines.zh: 又过了大概五分钟，我看见她正躲进神社一间废弃不用的旧屋子里。

lines.en: She doesn’t notice me approaching as she focuses on the world around her.
lines.zh: 她没有注意到我的靠近，只是专注地望着周围的世界。

lines.en: Dust particles, which had remained undisturbed for {s}God{/s} who knows how long, swim through the space around her and find their place among the air we breathe.
lines.zh: 那些不知被{s}神{/s}搁置了多久、一直无人打扰的尘埃，在她周围的空间里游动，最后在我们呼吸的空气里找到了自己的位置。

lines.en: Did you know that the average human being consumes almost 10 lbs of dust every year?
lines.zh: 你知道吗，普通人一年要吞下将近十磅的灰尘？

lines.en: I wonder how many other things we unknowingly consume.
lines.zh: 我想知道，还有多少别的东西是我们不知不觉吞下去的。

lines.en: I wonder how our lives would change if we knew about them.
lines.zh: 我想知道，如果我们知道了，人生会有怎样的改变。

lines.en: : Hey.
scene mayaglow2
: I found you.
lines.zh: : 我找到你了。

lines.en: : Yes. It appears you did.
lines.zh: : 是啊。看来是找到了。

lines.en: : I’m running out of safe places to take shelter.
lines.zh: : 我能躲的安全地方快用完了。

lines.en: : I might need to start tending to another shrine soon.
lines.zh: : 我可能很快就得开始照料另一座神社了。

lines.en: : Would you really go through the hassle of finding another shrine just to get away from me?
lines.zh: : 你真会为了躲我，而费那个劲去找另一座神社？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t need to find them. I know where they are.
lines.zh: : 我不需要去找。我知道它们在哪儿。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, could you tell me? I’d like to check them out.
lines.zh: : 哦。那你能告诉我吗？我想去看看。

lines.en: scene mayaglow3
: Do you really think I’m going to fall for such an obvious ploy?
lines.zh: : 你真以为我会上这么明显的圈套？

lines.en: : What ploy? Maybe I just...really like shrines?
lines.zh: : 什么圈套？也许我只是……真的很喜欢神社？

lines.en: : The first time you came here, you said you didn’t even know why you’d shown up.
lines.zh: : 你第一次来这儿的时候，说自己甚至不知道为什么会来。

lines.en: : I doubt that the time you’ve spent here has, in any way, sparked your interest in them.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑你在这儿待的这段时间，有没有以任何方式激起你对它们的兴趣。

lines.en: : I don’t even think I’ve seen you pray yet.
lines.zh: : 我甚至觉得我从没见你祈祷过。

lines.en: : And you likely never will. There’s no point in praying.
lines.zh: : 而你大概永远都不会。祈祷没有意义。

lines.en: scene mayaglow4
: A right and a wrong answer wrapped together in one sentence. How interesting.
lines.zh: : 一句话里同时包着对的答案和错的答案。真有意思。

lines.en: : What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 你这话什么意思？

lines.en: : Praying isn’t entirely pointless as long as the person doing it believes that something will happen in response.
lines.zh: : 只要祈祷的人相信会有某种回应，祈祷就不完全是毫无意义的。

lines.en: : Of course, this doesn’t change the fact that anything that comes subsequently will be the result of coincidence rather than divine intervention-
lines.zh: : 当然，这改变不了随后发生的任何事都是巧合、而非神的介入的结果——

lines.en: : But beliefs are beliefs nonetheless.
lines.zh: : 但信仰终究是信仰。

lines.en: : So is that why you spend so much time here? To help people believe?
lines.zh: : 那你在这儿花这么多时间，就是为了让人们去相信？

lines.en: scene mayaglow2
: Not at all. I couldn’t care less about what other people believe.
lines.zh: : 完全不是。别人信什么，我才懒得管。

lines.en: : I don’t even like shrines.
lines.zh: : 我甚至不喜欢神社。

lines.en: : Then you should probably find a job that you enjoy. I’m sure there are plenty of girls who actually believe in god who would be happy to spend their afternoons sweeping up here.
lines.zh: : 那你应该去找一份你喜欢的工作。我敢肯定，有很多真正信神的女孩会很乐意花下午的时间在这儿扫地。

lines.en: : Probably. But that’s just not how things are supposed to go.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。可事情本该如此。

lines.en: : Besides, I look cute in this dress.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我穿这身裙子很好看。

lines.en: : Can you honestly look at me and tell me I don’t belong here?
lines.zh: : 你能看着我，诚实地说我不属于这儿吗？

lines.en: : Actually, wait. Don’t answer that. I feel as if you’ll talk for hours on end about it.
lines.zh: : 等等，别回答。我感觉你会就这个说上好几个小时。

lines.en: : I like you more when you’re not being conceited.
lines.zh: : 你不自负的时候，我更喜欢你。

lines.en: : Then I will continue to praise myself so your disdain for me may grow as if it is a tree.
lines.zh: : 那我就继续赞美自己，好让你对我的厌恶像树一样生长。

lines.en: if trinity1track == True:
scene callous19
scene mayaglow2
I’m not sure what it is about that last sentence, but it pisses me off for some reason.
lines.zh: 我不知道结尾那句话有什么特别，但它莫名让我火大。

lines.en: It’s not uncommon for Maya to say things for the sole purpose of making me feel like shit, but that one was just different.
lines.zh: Maya 专门为了让我觉得自己是坨屎而说话，这并不罕见，但那句就是不一样。

lines.en: I wonder why?
lines.zh: 我想知道为什么？

lines.en: scene mayaglow4
: Are you excited for the cold?
lines.zh: : 你对即将到来的寒冷感到兴奋吗？

lines.en: : You’ve always liked winter more than summer.
lines.zh: : 你一直喜欢冬天多过夏天。

lines.en: : It’s one of the few things we have in common.
lines.zh: : 这是我们为数不多的共同点之一。

lines.en: : More than anything, I think I’m just excited to see everyone in their winter clothes.
lines.zh: : 不过最让我兴奋的，大概还是能看到大家穿上冬装。

lines.en: : Summer clothes are nice and all, but they just don’t have the same appeal as a girl dressed in layers.
lines.zh: : 夏装是不错，可总不如一个裹了一层又一层的女孩有吸引力。

lines.en: : You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : How is it disgusting wanting to see a girl in {i}more{/i} clothes?
lines.zh: : 想看女孩穿「{i}更{/i}多」衣服，有什么恶心的？

lines.en: : It’s disgusting that you felt compelled to share your sexual attractions with me in response to a wholesome question.
lines.zh: : 恶心的是，面对一个正经的问题，你却非要把自己的性癖分享给我。

lines.en: : What even are you?
lines.zh: : 你到底是什么东西？

lines.en: : I’m a normal [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: : 我是一个普通的[teenage]女孩。

lines.en: scene mayaglow5
: Why is everyone doing impressions of me lately?
lines.zh: : 最近为什么大家都在模仿我？

lines.en: : It’s starting to get on my nerves.
lines.zh: : 我开始有点恼火了。

lines.en: : To be fair, you make it very easy.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，是你让这事变得太容易了。

lines.en: scene mayaglow6
: Hah...Yes, I suppose I’ve become rather predictable over time.
lines.zh: : 哈……是啊，我想随着时间推移，我已经变得相当好猜了。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t excuse mocking someone.
lines.zh: : 可那也不能成为嘲笑别人的理由。

lines.en: : Please leave the shrine as penance for your actions here today.
lines.zh: : 请离开神社，作为你今天在这儿所作所为的赎罪。

lines.en: : Nah, I want to stay here and talk more about the weather with you.
lines.zh: : 不，我想留在这儿，跟你多聊聊天气。

lines.en: scene mayaglow7
: Wow, what an interesting topic for conversation.
lines.zh: : 哇，这话题可真有意思。

lines.en: : Weren’t {i}you{/i} the one who brought it up in the first place? I’m just following your lead.
lines.zh: : 一开始提起天气的不是「{i}你{/i}」吗？我只是顺着你的话往下走。

lines.en: : Being interesting hasn’t ever been one of my strong suits.
lines.zh: : 有趣从来都不是我的强项。

lines.en: : That’s not true. You’re plenty interesting.
lines.zh: : 才不是。你有趣得很。

lines.en: : Just in the “I have no idea what you’re talking about” way rather than the “What an exciting person to be around” sort of way.
lines.zh: : 只不过是属于「我完全听不懂你在说什么」的那种有趣，而不是「这人真让人兴奋」的那种。

lines.en: : Thank you for your wonderful, in-depth analysis of my character. Please include that in my recommendation letter for college.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你对我人格的精彩深入分析。请把它写进我的大学推荐信里。

lines.en: : Jokes on you. You’re never going to make it to college if the world keeps resetting every few months.
lines.zh: : 你开玩笑吧。要是世界每几个月就重置一次，你永远也上不了大学。

lines.en: scene mayaglow8
: No. I suppose I won’t.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我想是上不了。

lines.en: : Perhaps I’ll finally find it in myself to ask for a class-transfer once the next cycle starts?
lines.zh: : 也许等下一个循环开始，我终于能下定决心申请转班？

lines.en: : Oh, about that. There’s something I’ve been wondering.
lines.zh: : 哦，说到这个。有件事我一直很好奇。

lines.en: scene mayaglow9
: You? Wondering something?
lines.zh: : 你？好奇什么事？

lines.en: : I’m absolutely shocked.
lines.zh: : 我真是震惊极了。

lines.en: scene mayaglow2
: What is it?
lines.zh: : 是什么？

lines.en: : How exactly is this whole switch to winter thing going to work?
lines.zh: : 这个切换到冬天的过程，到底会怎么运作？

lines.en: : There’s not much time left in the[school] year as-is, so it seems like winter is going to fall right around the same time that things start over.
lines.zh: : 原本[school]年剩下的时间就不多了，所以冬天看起来正好会赶在一切重来的时候降临。

lines.en: : Correct.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : I'll be finalizing the switch during the next reset.
lines.zh: : 我会在下一次重置期间完成这个切换。

lines.en: : You can change the weather as well?
lines.zh: : 你连天气都能改？

lines.en: : Not exactly. It's complicated.
lines.zh: : 不完全是。说起来很复杂。

lines.en: : Well...won’t everyone think it’s a little weird if it’s snowing in the middle of the[school] year?
lines.zh: : 嗯……可是如果[school]年上到一半突然下雪，大家不会觉得有点怪吗？

lines.en: scene mayaglow1
: You really took your time asking that question, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你问这个问题可真是慢悠悠的啊。

lines.en: : You’re not wrong in being confused about it.
lines.zh: : 你对此感到困惑也不算错。

lines.en: : While it’s true that most people would think snow in the middle of the[school] year is strange, something about the flow of time here prevents that from happening.
lines.zh: : 虽然大多数人确实会觉得[school]年中间下雪很奇怪，可这里时间的流动方式让这种事不会发生。

lines.en: : It’s as if everyone’s perception of time itself resets along with the world.
lines.zh: : 就好像每个人对时间本身的认知，也跟着世界一起重置了。

lines.en: : It’s just one more thing I don’t yet understand.
lines.zh: : 这只是我还没弄明白的事情之一。

lines.en: : That sounds...strangely convenient.
lines.zh: : 听起来……方便得有点诡异。

lines.en: scene mayaglow11
: I can assure you that there is nothing convenient about this world at all.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，这个世界一点都不方便。

lines.en: : It’s filled with horrible things. Yourself included.
lines.zh: : 它充满了可怕的东西。包括你自己。

lines.en: : Oh come on. I didn’t even say anything to warrant being insulted this time.
lines.zh: : 拜托。这次我可什么都没说，不该被骂。

lines.en: : Your existence itself is enough to warrant being insulted.
lines.zh: : 光是你的存在，就足够构成被骂的理由了。

lines.en: : Thanks. I love you too.
lines.zh: : 谢了。我也爱你。

lines.en: scene mayaglow10
: Anyway...
lines.zh: : 总之……

lines.en: : You needn’t concern yourself with something as trivial as how those around you will think of snow during the[school] year.
lines.zh: : 你不必去操心那种鸡毛蒜皮的事，比如周围的人会怎么看[school]年里下雪这件事。

lines.en: : There are many things that will happen in the future that are sure to confuse you.
lines.zh: : 未来会发生很多注定让你困惑的事。

lines.en: : I am no exception to that.
lines.zh: : 我也不例外。

lines.en: : The important thing is that you live each day as if you are meant to be here.
lines.zh: : 重要的是，你要把每一天都当成自己本就该在这里那样去过。

lines.en: : Question everything, but accept that many things seem to come without answer.
lines.zh: : 质疑一切，但也要接受很多事情似乎没有答案。

lines.en: : But most importantly, don’t be afraid.
lines.zh: : 而最重要的，是不要害怕。

lines.en: : You, too, shall vanish one day.
lines.zh: : 你，也一样，总有一天会消失。

lines.en: : It’s absolutely imperative that you be ready for it at any given moment.
lines.zh: : 你必须随时为此做好准备，这一点绝对必要。

lines.en: I hate hearing things like that.
lines.zh: 我讨厌听到这种话。

lines.en: I heard it on the beach, too.
lines.zh: 在海滩上我也听到了。

lines.en: It’s great that someone like Maya exists to shine light on the world I was reborn into-
lines.zh: 能有 Maya 这样的人存在，为我重生其中的这个世界投下光，是件好事——

lines.en: But each time I’m reminded that my existence is just as fleeting as a six-month Summer, I can’t help but be swallowed by dread.
lines.zh: 可每次被提醒，我的存在就像一场六个月的夏天一样短暂，我就忍不住被恐惧吞没。

lines.en: It really could happen at any given moment.
lines.zh: 它真的可能在任何一刻发生。

lines.en: : What are you going to do if that does happen?
lines.zh: : 如果那真的发生了，你会怎么办？

lines.en: scene mayaglow11
: Hm?
: Do you mean if it happens to {i}you{/i}? Or if it happens to me?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}是说如果发生在「你」身上？还是发生在我身上？

lines.en: : Both, I guess.
lines.zh: : 都有吧，大概。

lines.en: : How would your life change if this version of me were to vanish?
lines.zh: : 如果这个版本的我消失了，你的人生会有什么改变？

lines.en: : And how would it change if you were the one to vanish instead?
lines.zh: : 而如果是你消失，又会有什么改变？

lines.en: : I don’t like that question. Ask a new one.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这个问题。换个新的。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : It’s not easy to answer. It would take far too long.
lines.zh: : 这不容易回答。要说清楚太花时间了。

lines.en: : Let me ask you a question instead.
lines.zh: : 让我问你一个问题吧。

lines.en: : What would {i}you{/i} do if this version of me vanished?
lines.zh: : 如果这个版本的我消失了，「{i}你{/i}」会怎么做？

lines.en: : What if, after the next reset, there was a brand new Maya Makinami?
lines.zh: : 如果下一次重置之后，出现了一个全新的 Maya Makinami 呢？

lines.en: : One who didn’t know too much about the world.
lines.zh: : 一个对这个世界知道得不太多的。

lines.en: : One who didn’t know too much about you.
lines.zh: : 一个对你知道得不太多的。

lines.en: : Would you treat her the same way you treat everyone else?
lines.zh: : 你会像对待其他所有人那样对待她吗？

lines.en: : With lascivious glances and spontaneous visits to her dorm room in the middle of the night?
lines.zh: : 用淫邪的眼神，还有半夜突然造访她的宿舍？

lines.en: : Would you view her as another piece of the puzzle? Another girl in the harem?
lines.zh: : 你会把她当成拼图的另一块吗？后宫里的又一个女孩？

lines.en: : Or would you try to bring the old one back?
lines.zh: : 还是说，你会试着把原来那个带回来？

lines.en: : You’re right. This {i}is{/i} a hard question.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。这「{i}确实{/i}」是个很难的问题。

lines.en: While I do like the idea of a Maya who doesn’t look at me with dead eyes every time I see her, would that {i}really{/i} be Maya?
lines.zh: 虽然我确实喜欢一个不会每次见我都用死鱼眼看我的 Maya，可那「{i}真的{/i}」还是 Maya 吗？

lines.en: No. Of course not.
lines.zh: 不。当然不是。

lines.en: Even if she had all the same interests...watermelons and violin, those dead eyes are what I expect to see each and every time we meet.
lines.zh: 就算她有完全一样的兴趣……西瓜和小提琴，可那双死鱼眼，是我每次见到她都预期会看到的。

lines.en: Replacing them with brand new ones just wouldn’t feel right.
lines.zh: 换上一双全新的眼睛，怎么都不会对劲。

lines.en: scene mayaglow12
: I’m glad you understand.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你明白。

lines.en: : You haven’t been here long, so I won’t fault you for believing that a world like this has its own unique set of benefits and positives.
lines.zh: : 你在这儿待的时间不长，所以我不会怪你相信这样一个世界有它独特的好处与正面之处。

lines.en: : But the negatives that come with it are much worse.
lines.zh: : 可随之而来的负面要糟糕得多。

lines.en: : It’s hard enough living each day knowing that death could come at any moment.
lines.zh: : 光是知道死亡可能在任何一刻降临，就已经够难熬了。

lines.en: : But a place like this will remind you of that with each and every passing second.
lines.zh: : 而这样一个地方，会在每一秒里都提醒你这一点。

lines.en: : Nothing lasts forever, even when it does.
lines.zh: : 没有什么是永恒的，即便它是永恒的。

lines.en: scene mayaglow2
: Well, I suppose that’s enough sentimentality and exposition for the day.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我想今天的多愁善感和背景铺陈已经够多了。

lines.en: : Please leave now.
lines.zh: : 请离开吧。

lines.en: : Wait, really? I thought we were about to have a breakthrough.
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？我还以为我们马上就要有突破了。

lines.en: : We were not.
lines.zh: : 并没有。

lines.en: : But what about all of that stuff about how death could come at any moment? What if I disappear on the way home?
lines.zh: : 可那些关于死亡随时可能降临的话呢？万一我在回家的路上消失了呢？

lines.en: : Wouldn't you be upset?
lines.zh: : 你不会难过吗？

lines.en: : I have the worst luck out of anyone in the world, so I firmly believe you’ll be back here as soon as you possibly can be.
lines.zh: : 我是全世界运气最差的人，所以我坚信你会以最快的速度回到这儿来。

lines.en: : Well {i}sorry{/i} that my continued living adds to your misfortune.
lines.zh: : 那真「{i}抱歉{/i}」，我还活着给你添了这么多不幸。

lines.en: : Apology accepted. Goodbye now.
lines.zh: : 道歉接受。再见吧。

lines.en: : ...Fine.
: But I’m only leaving because I have other stuff to do.
lines.zh: : 不过我走只是因为我还有别的事要做。

lines.en: : And to think you’ve called {i}me{/i} tsundere on multiple occasions...
lines.zh: : 想想看，你居然还多次说「{i}我{/i}」是傲娇……

lines.en: scene black
The dust settles and the sun begins to disappear behind the clouds.
lines.zh: 尘埃落定，太阳开始消失在云层后面。

lines.en: Maya retreats into another section of the shrine and I, just as always, must figure out what to do with the rest of my time today...
lines.zh: Maya 退进神社的另一个区域，而我，一如既往地得想清楚今天剩下的时间该怎么打发……

lines.en: $ maya_love += 1
$ shrine25 = True
{i}Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
